0022600037.text: The Atlanta Hawks (7-5, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East) visit the Chicago Bulls (1-9, 14th in the East) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, with Atlanta coming off a loss and 5-5 over its last ten while Chicago has lost eight straight and is 0-4 at home. Atlanta is without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Chicago's Caleb Wilson (hand), Dailyn Swain (back), Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation) and Tobe Awaka (back) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Atlanta lost all three meetings with Chicago in 2025-26, most recently a 126-123 defeat in Atlanta on December 23, 2025.
